name: Knight Sava Orrin
title: The archive lamp
text: Sava keeps one lamp lit beside the unfinished records. 'A name is not a footnote. Who will read these when we are gone?'

choices.label: Keep every witness's name
choices.follow: Sava kept the witness names in the public record.

choices.label: Mark the pattern for the next mission
choices.follow: Sava marked a pattern in the witness records for the next patrol.

name: Tor Saalen
title: A useful edge
text: Tor holds a repaired hilt to the light. 'It is tempting to call a weapon finished. Tell me what it must survive.'

choices.label: Build for the next squad
choices.follow: Tor set aside a sound crystal for the next squad.

choices.label: Study the fracture first
choices.follow: Tor's fracture notes reached the Archives.

name: Doc Bren
title: A chair by the bed
text: Doc Bren has pulled a chair beside a wounded trooper. 'They ask whether the others made it home. Sit with them a while.'

choices.label: Stay until they can sleep
choices.follow: Bren recorded a quiet visit to the healing ward.

choices.label: Ask what the squad missed
choices.follow: Bren passed the patient's account to Comms.

name: Kira Venn
title: A voice beneath the static
text: Kira hears a distress call between routine reports. 'There is no location yet. But someone is still answering.'

choices.label: Keep the channel open
choices.follow: Kira held the channel open until the voice answered again.

choices.label: Trace the signal
choices.follow: Kira saved a narrow bearing from the weak signal.

name: Kira Venn & Tor Saalen
title: After the watch
text: {a} finds {b} awake after lights out. Neither asks for a report. 'Will you sit with me?'

choices.label: Give them the hour together
choices.follow: {a} and {b} found an hour to speak without orders.

choices.label: Let them keep a quiet watch
choices.follow: {a} and {b} kept watch together until dawn.

name: {a}
title: A name spoken aloud
text: {a} reads {fallen}'s name from the stone. 'What should the next squad hear when they ask who stood here?'

choices.label: Tell them how {fallen} lived
choices.follow: The Memorial carries {fallen}'s life, not only the loss.

choices.label: Promise to remember the cost
choices.follow: At the Memorial, the Order chose remembrance over anger for {fallen}.

name: Satele Shan
title: The long window
text: Satele stands by the Council window after the chamber empties. 'We can send orders from here. We must also hear what comes back.'

choices.label: Invite the field's account
choices.follow: Satele invited the field's account into the Council chamber.

choices.label: Ask for the unedited report
choices.follow: Satele requested the unedited field report.

name: Kira Venn & Tor Saalen
title: The familiar seat
text: {b} leaves a place at the table for {a}. It is a small habit, but both notice when it is kept.

choices.label: Share the meal
choices.follow: {a} and {b} shared a meal after the watch.

choices.label: Save the place for tomorrow
choices.follow: {b} saved a seat for {a} the next evening.

name: {a}
title: The second candle
text: The candle beneath {fallen}'s name has burned low. {a} asks if it should be lit again.

choices.label: Light it for those still serving
choices.follow: A second candle for {fallen} steadied those still serving.

choices.label: Let the record speak
choices.follow: {a} copied {fallen}'s final account into the Archives.

name: Kira Venn
title: The second signal
text: Kira replays the gate call. 'They withdrew too cleanly. I am keeping this channel open.'

choices.label: Trust Kira with the watch
choices.follow: Kira kept watch for the second signal after the gate.

name: Knight Sava Orrin
title: What came home
text: Sava opens a fresh ledger. 'A witness or a record can still tell us where the envoy went.'

choices.label: Keep the evidence close
choices.follow: Sava kept the second mission evidence beside the envoy file.

name: Satele Shan
title: The next watch
text: Satele closes the envoy file. 'Malgus is still moving. Keep the people who found this trail together.'

choices.label: Keep the squad together
choices.follow: Satele kept the envoy squad on the next watch.

name: {a}
title: After the first loss
text: {a} stops at {fallen}'s name. 'We will say it before the next deployment.'

choices.label: Speak the name
choices.follow: The squad spoke {fallen}’s name before deploying again.

name: Temple
title: The rooms endure
text: Every chamber keeps its own watch.

flavours.council: The chamber waits for voices from the field.
flavours.archives: A lamp burns over the unfinished records.
flavours.armory: Freshly repaired hilts line the bench.
flavours.comms: A faint signal slips through the static.
flavours.gardens: Leaves stir beside the meditation stones.
flavours.barracks: Someone has saved a seat for a friend.
flavours.medical: A chair waits beside the healing beds.
flavours.forge: A crystal glows beneath the forge tongs.
flavours.hangar: Crews check the ships between patrols.
flavours.works: Builders measure the next empty bay.
flavours.under: The lower passages hum with trade.
flavours.a0: Dust gathers on the western threshold.
flavours.a1: The eastern bay waits for its first crew.
flavours.u0: A sealed door guards the kyber below.
flavours.u1: Old voices sleep behind the vault seal.
flavours.u2: Names wait in the quiet stone.
flavours.sp0: A narrow stair climbs toward knowledge.
flavours.sp1: A watchlight steadies the upper hall.
flavours.sp2: The tower keeps room for reconciliation.
flavours.sp3: A high window looks toward the fleet.
